fact: The LONDA 2023 report, published April 2024, found a lack of consultation with ICT players, civil society and the public in developing the Cybercrimes Bill 2023, while MACRA said it circulated the draft for comment by email, newspapers, its website and Facebook and planned physical meetings in January 2024.
title: LONDA 2023 Digital Rights and Inclusion in Africa Report: Malawi
